election: Zurich city presidency (Stadtpräsidium) election, second round
role_sought: Stadtpräsident (Mayor) of the City of Zurich
vote_share: Approx. 42,000 votes; roughly 9,500 votes went to scattered/independent names
opponent: No official rival candidate (Golta ran as the only candidate; runoff required by municipal rules even with a single candidate)
detail: After missing the absolute majority in the first round, Golta won the second round as the sole candidate and succeeded long-serving SP mayor Corine Mauch.

election: Zurich city presidency (Stadtpräsidium) election, first round
role_sought: Stadtpräsident (Mayor) of the City of Zurich
result: Top result but missed absolute majority; forced into a runoff
opponent: Përparim Avdili (FDP), who drew votes from Golta but failed to be elected to the city executive
detail: Golta led the field but fell short of the absolute majority, partly because FDP challenger Avdili took votes; a second round was scheduled.

election: Zurich city executive (Stadtrat) general renewal election
role_sought: Member of the Zurich city executive (Stadtrat)
opponent: Multi-candidate executive race; SP and Greens expanded their seats (7 of 9 seats left-green)
detail: Golta was returned to the nine-seat city executive in an election that produced the most left-leaning Zurich city government to date.

election: Zurich city executive (Stadtrat) general renewal election
role_sought: Member of the Zurich city executive (Stadtrat)
detail: First elected to the Zurich Stadtrat; subsequently took over the Social Department and resigned from the cantonal parliament.
Elected to the cantonal parliament in May 2003; served until 2014.
